title: Registration route has no direct route-level test coverage
reasoning: The /api/register/ route is a network-facing, user-input and auth-adjacent endpoint, but the included linked tests exercise unrelated Bible, devotional, email, fast, and admin behaviors and do not make a request to /api/register/ or assert the route is wired to the intended view. This leaves regressions such as accidentally removing or renaming the route, changing allowed methods, or returning an incompatible registration response uncaught by the shown test set.
recommendation: Add a focused API test for /api/register/ that posts the minimum valid registration payload and asserts the expected status, response contract, and user creation side effect; include at least one invalid-payload case.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover other endpoints and utilities, but none call /api/register/ or reverse auth_register.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use the DRF test client to POST to /api/register/ with valid credentials, assert the expected success status and response fields, then assert the user exists; add a second POST with missing/invalid required fields and assert a validation error without user creation.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests for auth_register/RegisterView behavior.
